summarizer._maxInputChars: 6,000 rather than the education project's 24,000: this site summarizes abstracts (1,000-2,600 characters), not news articles. It also keeps one call inside Groq's free-tier 6,000 tokens per minute, which 24,000 would not, and shrinks the prompt-injection surface.

providers._note: Primary. The education site has produced acceptable Traditional Chinese on this model for weeks; reasoningEffort 'none' is not optional - without it the model returns a page of reasoning prose and no JSON, and the whole batch fails.

Fallback, chosen by measurement on 2026-08-26 rather than from memory. Tested against qwen/qwen3.8-27b on a real abstract: qwen was six times faster (489ms vs 3,011ms) and used a tenth of the tokens (118 vs 1,181), and both wrote clean Traditional Chinese with no simplified characters. gpt-oss-120b was chosen anyway because qwen added a conclusion the abstract did not contain ('exposes a serious safety hole'), and the prompt forbids adding anything. On a site that publishes unread, faithfulness beats speed.
